logp.method_description: The flask-shaking method by PUCKETT and BARTON (2007) was used for determination of the lipophilicity of the complexes Ag1 and Ag2. These complexes were dissolved in DMSO and added to water/n-octanol system. After that, the solutions were vortexed for 1 h at ambient temperature and left to stand for an additional 24 h allowing the separation of the two phases. The values of absorbance were determined from the previously determined calibration curves and used for calculation of the concentration of the complexes in two phases (co is the concentration of the complexes in n-octanol phase, while cw represents their concentration in water phase)
